observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same item: a handheld steaming iron with a black and gold body, resting on a blue patterned fabric.
The iron has a black handle, a gold-colored front panel, and a black nozzle on the side.
A black base unit with a power cord is visible below the iron; it has a switch and indicator lights.
The base unit has some text and symbols, including a lock icon and a power symbol, but the brand name is not clearly legible.
The iron appears to be corded, as a power cord is connected to the base unit.
There is visible wear on the iron’s body, including scuffs and minor scratches.
The seller claims it is 'high quality', 'tested', 'working very well', and 'nothing to fix'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a power cord connected to the base unit, indicating it is corded. There is no sign of a rechargeable battery or cordless operation.
Quality is subjective and cannot be assessed from photos alone. No visible defects or damage are obvious, but internal components or performance cannot be verified remotely.
No photo shows the iron in operation or any testing process. The claim is not supported by visual evidence.
No visual proof of operation (e.g., steam emission, power indicator lit). The iron may be non-functional despite appearance.
No inspection of internal components or electrical connections is visible. Wear on the exterior does not confirm internal functionality.

risks.risk: The iron may not produce steam or may be electrically faulty.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the iron turned on, producing steam, and the base unit’s indicator lights functioning.

risks.risk: The power cord or base unit may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the power cord, plug, and base unit connections, showing no fraying, burns, or loose parts.

risks.risk: The iron may have internal mineral buildup or clogged nozzle, affecting performance.
risks.proof: Video of steam being emitted from the nozzle while the iron is in use.

proof_requests: Video of the iron in operation, showing steam emission and base unit lights.
Close-up photo of the power cord, plug, and base unit connections.
Photo of the brand name or model number if visible on the iron or base unit.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a handheld steaming iron, but critical claims about functionality and condition cannot be verified from the photos. The presence of a power cord contradicts the 'cordless' claim. Without proof of operation and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be assessed further.
